S. B. REGISTER
No. S. B. D. 1039 A/34
Date 30 / 12 / 37

Reference, Two boys found in possession of a number of Anti Japanese
pamphlets and envelopes.

D.S. 20 Bretherton.

Sir,

At 4.05 p.m. on the 30-12-37 one named Liang Tsi Yuen
(梁世炎) employed in the capacity of private detective by the
Sincere Company, Nanking Road, brought to this Station two boys,
named Tsau Wan Shang (趙萬生), 13, Shantung, and Woo Tsung Ho
(何宗和), 14, Chinkiang, both resident at the Chengtu Road
Police Quarters, whom he found in possession of a number of
Anti Japanese pamphlets.

Enquiries by C.D.C. 275 and D.S. Bretherton revealed the
following: that the above two described youths, whilst passing
the time away in the Sincere Store at about 4 p.m. 30-12-37
they picked up from the staircase, that part which is situated
between the second and third floors, eight sheets of Anti
Japanese literature and sixteen envelopes, which were lying in
a bundle.

At no time were the two boys observed distributing the
pamphlets. The two boys are of, apparently, parentage with
a measure of respectability, the first named being the younger
brother of C.P.C. 592 attached Central Station, whilst the
second named is the son of C.P.C. 1731 attached Chengtu Road
Station, both are resident at the Chengtu Road Police Quarters.

Verified.

The two boys were eventually allowed to go in custody of
their elder brother and father, respectively.

Special Branch informed. Clerk Liao Chung Chien (廖中泉)
attended taking away with him one copy (Anti Japanese pamphlet).

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
J. Black O.I.J.

日期 1937年12月30日

事由：两名男孩被发现持有若干反日传单及信封。

警佐 20号 Bretherton。

先生：

1937年12月30日下午4时05分，一名名为梁世炎（Liang Tsi Yuen）的男子，受雇于南京路先施公司担任私家侦探，将两名男孩带至本巡捕房。这两名男孩分别为赵万生（Tsau Wan Shang），13岁，山东人；何宗和（Woo Tsung Ho），14岁，镇江人。两人均居住在成都路警察宿舍。梁世炎发现他们持有若干反日传单。

经刑事侦缉处警员 275号及警佐 Bretherton 调查，查明情况如下：上述两名青年于1937年12月30日下午4时许在先施百货公司消磨时间时，在位于二楼与三楼之间的楼梯处，拾得一捆散落的八张反日宣传品及十六个信封。

未曾观察到这两名男孩分发传单。这两名男孩的家世背景似乎尚属体面，前者系中央巡捕房华籍巡长 592号的弟弟，后者系成都路巡捕房华籍巡长 1731号的儿子，两人均居住在成都路警察宿舍。

经查属实。

这两名男孩最终分别由其兄长和父亲领回监护。

已通知特别课。职员廖中泉（Liao Chung Chien）到场，取走一份（反日传单）。

此致，
敬礼，
J. Black O.I.J.

Local refugee camps have recently received through
the mail, copies of a mimeographed notice from a so-called
"Refugee Camp Workers' Lien Nyi (Mutual Friendship) Society"
(難民收容所工作人員聯誼社 ), which instructs the
camps to celebrate the forthcoming New Year in accordance
with the measures laid down by the society. A full
copy of the notice together with the measures to be taken
in the celebration has been obtained from the 40th Refugee
Camp, situated in the premises of the Temple of Heaven, and
is forwarded herewith together with full translations.

Enquiries conducted at various refugee camps and
also the Disaster Relief Federation of Shanghai Benevolent
Societies, 35 Yunnan Road, and its "Refugees' Relief Branch",
1454 Avenue Edward VII, which organization takes charge of
most of the local camps, have failed to ascertain the
whereabouts of the so-called "Refugee Camp Workers' Lien
Nyi Society" or who the sponsors are, but it is reasonable
to believe from the nature of the instructions that the local
"national salvation" elements are behind this movement to
further their propaganda campaign scheduled between
December 25 and January 3 in refugee camps.

The refugee camps in the Settlement, totalling 151,
are controlled and managed by the following organizations :-

1937年12月24日 ____ 难民营，

中华民国二十七年元旦即将来临。为庆祝中华民国人民解放神圣战争开始后的第一个元旦，本社已起草相关措施，现随函附上该措施副本，供贵方参考执行。

为庆祝这一具有划时代意义的元旦，本社还将募集捐款，用于购买旗帜和新年贺卡，赠送给各难民营。届时将向贵难民营赠送一套此类物品。

12月25日至1月3日期间，各慰问团将访问各难民营。请在他们到达时予以接待。

（盖章）上海难民营工作人员联谊社。

pages.en:
Translation

Measures to Celebrate New Year's Day
(proposed by the Refugee Camp Workers' Lien
Nyi Society).

I) Programme for the New Year's Celebration Meeting

1. Flag-raising (prior to the ceremony, the meaning
of the national flag will be explained to
the refugees) and singing of the flag raising
and Party songs.

2. An explanation of the importance of celebrating
the New Year's Day, by the Chairman.

3. National flag presentation (flags will be presented
by the Refugee Camp Workers' Lien Nyi Society
to various refugee camps, for exhibition at
these places. Representatives from among the
refugees may be appointed to accept the flags).

4. Speeches (to be delivered by guests, officers in
charge of refugee camps, employees of refugee
camps and refugees).

5. Oath-taking (oaths against becoming traitors,
dealing in Japanese goods and working for the
enemy, will be administered). (The wording
of the oaths to be drawn up by those administering)

6. Shouting of slogans (Down with traitors; Oppose
traitors' organizations ; Down with Japanese
imperialism ; Long live the Republic of
China ; Support General Chiang Kai-shek in
prosecuting the war of resistance to the end !)

7. Other items (to be added by the refugee camp
concerned).

II) Celebration Group

From six to ten refugees including the members
of the Celebration Group organized by teachers for
juveniles in each refugee camp will be appointed
representatives to pay New Year's visits to various
other refugee camp. (Visitors should carry with them
New Year Greeting Cards presented by the Refugee Camp
Workers' Lien Nyi Society). There will be more fun
if the refugees appointed can make speeches and sing.

庆祝元旦措施
（由难民营工作人员联谊社提议）。

I) 新年庆祝大会程序

1. 升旗（仪式前向难民解释国旗含义）并唱升旗歌及党歌。

2. 主席阐述庆祝元旦的重要性。

3. 授予国旗（国旗将由难民营工作人员联谊社授予各难民营，在这些地方展示。可从难民中指派代表接受国旗）。

4. 演讲（由嘉宾、难民营负责人、难民营职员及难民发表）。

5. 宣誓（主持宣誓者将拟定誓词，内容包括誓不成为汉奸、不买卖日货、不为敌人工作）。

6. 呼口号（打倒汉奸；反对汉奸组织；打倒日本帝国主义；中华民国万岁；拥护蒋介石将军抗战到底！）

7. 其他项目（由相关难民营添加）。

II) 庆祝小组

每个难民营中，由教师组织的青少年庆祝小组成员及六至十名难民将被指派为代表，前往其他各难民营拜年。（访客应携带由难民营工作人员联谊社赠送的新年贺卡）。如果被指派的难民能够发表演讲和唱歌，气氛将更加热烈。

(a) 12月25日既是云南起义纪念日，也是蒋介石将军从西安安全返回南京的纪念日，同时也是外国人庆祝的圣诞节。在这个节日里，本地公共团体和机关将开展“救济募捐运动”。我们应支持该运动，在此期间，我们应将传播抗日和救国宣传以及组织抗日统一战线的工作纳入其中。
(b) 1月1日是中华民国成立27周年纪念日。本地商业机构将在1月1日至3日或5日放假休业，因此市民能够开展系统的宣传和组织工作。12月25日至1月3日之间的工作应是连续的，我们应加速我们的活动。

A Letter to the People from General Chiang Kai-shek

Since the commencement of the war of resistance, about
300,000 casualties have been suffered by China in addition to
losses sustained by the people. The sacrifices made in this
war by China are the heaviest of all wars waged by her against
foreign aggression. As the Commander-in-Chief of the Chinese
Forces, I feel more aggrieved over these losses than any one
and so long as I live, I will dedicate myself to the continuance
of the war of resistance in order that a final victory for the
race and nation may be obtained.

There are two ways by which the enemy may prosecute her
invasion of China. One is to annex China at one swallow and
the other is to annex her by continual nibblings. The enemy
has now shown its preference for the first method by the
occupation of Nanking. The method previously adopted by the
enemy was the second of the two methods. By this way, China
would come under the control of the enemy without the people
being aware of the ultimate magnitude of the invasion. Now that
the enemy has chosen the method of swallowing China at one gulp,
the people are made aware of the national crises, and consequently
the present tactics adopted by the enemy are favourable to China.
China's policy is to prolong the war of resistance. It is not
by the capture of the city of Nanking or any other large city
that a final victory can be claimed. It depends upon the
determination of the people and the extensive defence put up
by all the villages in the country for a final victory. If the
fathers warn their sons and the elder brothers their younger
brothers of the inevitability of the war of resistance, every
village in the 40,000,000 square miles of territory which

蒋介石将军致民众书

自抗战开始以来，除人民遭受的损失外，中国已伤亡约30万人。中国在这场战争中的牺牲，是其历次反抗外来侵略战争中最沉重的。作为中国军队总司令，我对这些损失的感受比任何人都更为悲痛，只要我活着，我将致力于继续抗战，以求得民族和国家的最终胜利。

敌人侵华有两种方式。一种是一口吞并中国，另一种是不断蚕食。敌人现在通过占领南京表明了其偏好第一种方式。敌人此前采用的是第二种方式。通过这种方式，中国将在人民未意识到入侵最终严重性的情况下落入敌人控制之中。既然敌人选择了吞并中国的方式，人民便意识到了国家危机，因此敌人目前采取的战术对中国是有利的。中国的政策是 prolong（延长）抗战。最终胜利并非取决于占领南京或其他大城市。它取决于人民的决心以及全国所有村庄进行的广泛防御以取得最终胜利。如果父亲告诫儿子，兄长告诫弟弟抗战的不可避免性，那么构成中国的4000万平方英里领土上的每个村庄都将成为坚固防守的堡垒，并对敌人造成致命打击。在这种情况下，人民

should not worry over the temporary setbacks which China has
suffered, but should be determined to continue the war of
resistance and have confidence in a final victory being secured
by China. For the information of the people, I point out the
following:-
1) The present war of resistance is a necessary process in
the evolution of the people. If the people desire independence
and freedom for the nation and a re-constructed China, it is
necessary for the people to face this war of resistance. This
war is a struggle between the invaded and the invaders, or,
the followers of the "Three People's Principles" against
the imperialistic aggressors. We were fully aware, even
at the very beginning of the war, of the inferiority
of the Chinese armaments, but the revolutionary spirit
shown by the people is far superior. The histories of
the various countries of the world show that the more
hardships and privations endured by a nation in the
course of its evolution, the greater will be its ultimate
victory. Everything depends upon the unswerving determination
of the people. The object of the enemy is not only the
complete subjugation of China, but the massacring of her
people, the destruction of her culture, the extinction of
the "Three People's Principles" and the dissipation of
the revolutionary spirit of the people. So long as this
revolutionary spirit remains, so long will the nation exist.
If we surrender at this stage, the nation will perish and
the life of the people will be the life of beasts of burden
and their sufferings will be one hundred times heavier than
those at present being sustained by them. The people should
know that to attain the objects of a revolution and to relieve
their country of the oppression attendant upon invasion,
heavy sacrifices are required of the people. For the sake
of preserving the nation for ourselves and posterity, we
must not flinch from making a sacrifice, however great it

1) 目前的抗战是民族进化过程中的必要阶段。如果人民希望国家独立自由和一个重建的中国，就必须面对这场抗战。这场战争是被侵略者与侵略者之间的斗争，或者说，是“三民主义”追随者反对帝国主义侵略者的斗争。即使在战争初期，我们就充分意识到中国武器装备的劣势，但人民所表现出的革命精神远为优越。世界各国的历史表明，一个国家在进化过程中经受的艰难困苦越多，其最终的胜利就越大。一切取决于人民坚定不移的决心。敌人的目的不仅是完全征服中国，而且是屠杀其人民，毁灭其文化，消灭“三民主义”，并瓦解人民的革命精神。只要这种革命精神存在，国家就将存在。如果我们在此时投降，国家将灭亡，人民的生活将如同牛马一般，其痛苦将是目前所受痛苦的一百倍。人民应当知道，为了实现革命目标并解除国家因入侵而遭受的压迫，需要人民做出巨大的牺牲。为了为我们自己和后代保存国家，无论牺牲多大，我们都绝不能退缩。

2) Since we are made aware of the inevitablity of the war
of resistance as a necessary process in China's
evolution, we must go forward in the direction indicated,
no matter how unfavourably the situation develops for
China. Although we are not sure of a final victory even
if we continue to resist, yet to surrender to the enemy
at present would be to accelerate the destruction of China.
Rather suffer defeat in the war of resistance than perish
by surrendering. Defeats may turn out to be victories, but
a country once destroyed can never again be resuscitated.
Active resistance will bring us ultimate victory; passive
resistance will ensure our immediate defeat. The present

to subjugate China without fighting, but China throughout

in his original objective. The deeper the enemy penetrates,
the more difficult will his position become. If the enemy
desires to occupy the 40,000,000 square miles of China's
territory and to massacre her 400,000,000 people, consider

If all the people refuse to submit and continue to resist,

known to the people the aim of the struggle which is two

Although the international sanctions against the enemy have
not been enforced completely, yet the right or wrong of the

TRANSLATION

Notice No.9 purporting to emanate from the Shanghai Vocational
Circles National Salvation Association, dated 17/12/37, re
Employment Protection Propaganda Movement

The year end is fast approaching and the business concerns
will discharge on that occasion a large number of their employees
especially those who took an active part in the national sal-
vation movement and incurred the displeasure of their employers.
An increase in the figures of the unemployed will tend to
obstruct the development of the national salvation movement
and we have decided to adopt the following principal points
and measures:-

Principal Points

1. Demand and persuade the management of the concerns to
refrain from utilizing the occasion to dismiss their
employees.

2. Demand employment protection by united force and peaceful
terms.

3. To apply boycotts against the unpatriotic merchants who
oppress the national salvation movement.

Measures

1. The committee members of the national salvation
associations should request the leading merchants
and official organs to persuade the business firms
to refrain from discharging their employees.

2. The members of the various organizations should
lead the people in a movement to request the news-
paper offices, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, and
the various trade associations to maintain and safe-
guard the living of the employees.
pages.zh:
译文

第九号通告，声称发自上海职业界救国会，日期为1937年12月17日，关于就业保护宣传运动

年终将至，各商号届时将解雇大量雇员，尤其是那些积极参与救国运动并招致雇主不满者。失业人数的增加往往会阻碍救国运动的发展，我们决定采取以下主要方针和措施：-

主要方针

1. 要求并劝告各商号管理层不要利用此时机解雇其雇员。

2. 以联合力量和和平方式要求保障就业。

3. 对压迫救国运动的不爱国商人实行抵制。

措施

1. 各救国会的委员应请求商界领袖和官方机构劝告各商号不要解雇其雇员。

2. 各团体成员应领导民众开展运动，要求报馆、上海总商会及各同业公会维持并保障雇员的生活。

pages.en:
- 2 -

3. The publications issued by the national salvation
associations should carry out propaganda in connection
with the movement.

4. The members of the various national salvation associations
should direct the employees of the business concerns
in forming "Employment Protection Mutual Aid Associations"

5. The national salvation bodies should address the big
business concerns requesting them not to discharge their
employees. In the letters, the national salvation
bodies are advised not to use their bona-fide names.

The various bodies, on receiving this notice, should
convene meetings to discuss the enforcement of the above mea-
sures and report the result to Tsu Wei (pseudonym of the
Shanghai Vocational Circles National Salvation Association.)

Tsu Wei. 17/12/37.

3. 各救国会发行的刊物应配合该运动进行宣传。

4. 各救国会的成员应指导各商号雇员组建“就业保护互助会”。

5. 各救国团体应向大型商号致函，请求其不要解雇雇员。在信函中，建议各救国团体不要使用其真实名称。

各团体收到本通告后，应召开会议讨论上述措施的执行情况，并将结果报告给祖伟（上海职业界救国会的化名）。

pages.en:
TRANSLATION

Notice No.10 purporting to emanate from the Shanghai vocational
Circles National Salvation Association, dated 17/12/37, re
extension of propaganda movement on the occasion of Christmas,
Anniversary of Yunnan Uprising and the New Year.

Christmas will fall on December 25 coinciding with the
Anniversary of Yunnan Uprising and the Anniversary of the
Release of General Chiang Kai Shek from Sian. Six days
after Christmas will be the New Year. We must avail our-
selves of the opportunity to extend our propaganda and streng-
then the national salvation spirit of the masses. Tsu Wei
(pseudonym of the Shanghai Vocational Circles National Salvation
Association) has decided to carry out a propaganda campaign
along the following lines between December 25, 1937 and
January 1, 1938:-

1. The various national salvation associations should unite
together to extend the movement.

2. The various organizations should solicit cotton padded
clothes, food, etc. of their own accord. They should
proceed to console refugees and wounded soldiers on
December 25, and form children's classes and women's
associations.

3. Every effort should be made to obtain permission to use
"public places" and schools to hold meetings on December 25
to celebrate Christmas. The public should be urged to
participate and in the meetings, programmes of a national
salvation nature should be included in celebrating the
Anniversary of Yunnan Uprising and the Anniversary of the
Release of General Chiang Kai Shek from Sian.

4. During the propaganda week, the cells of the various
organizations should hold meetings to discuss the relation
between the Yunnan Uprising and the war of resistance.

第十号通告，声称发自上海职业界救国会，日期为1937年12月17日，关于借圣诞节、云南起义纪念日及新年之际扩大宣传运动。

圣诞节将于12月25日到来，恰逢云南起义纪念日及蒋介石将军西安获释纪念日。圣诞节后六天即为新年。我们必须利用这一机会扩大宣传，加强群众的救国精神。祖伟（上海职业界救国会的化名）决定于1937年12月25日至1938年1月1日期间，按下列方针开展宣传运动：-

1. 各救国会应联合起来扩大运动。

2. 各团体应主动募集棉衣、食品等物资。他们应于12月25日前去慰问难民和伤兵，并开办儿童班和妇女协会。

3. 应尽一切努力争取许可，使用“公共场所”和学校于12月25日举行会议庆祝圣诞节。应敦促公众参与，并在会议中纳入具有救国性质的节目，以庆祝云南起义纪念日及蒋介石将军西安获释纪念日。

4. 在宣传周期间，各团体的小组应举行会议，讨论云南起义与抗日战争之间的关系。

pages.en:
- 2 -

5. During the week, the various organizations should persuade
the people to write to Gen. Chiang to show their support
in the war of resistance.

6. The Vocational Circles National Salvation Association has
prepared a large number of "National Salvation" greeting
cards which will be distributed to Chinese and foreigners
alike. Other organizations are requested to follow this
example.

7. The Vocational Circles National Salvation Association has
prepared a large number of national flags and will distribute
them to the various residents in the alleyways as well as
shops for them to display on the anniversaries. Other
organizations are requested to do likewise.

8. When the national flags are distributed to the residents and
shops, the people should be informed of the importance of
supporting the national flag. If possible, organizations
entitled "Ten Men's Association to Support the National
Flag" may be formed.

9. The various organizations should induce the residents and
shops to hoist flags on December 25, 1937 and Jan. 1, 1938.

10. On January 1, 1938 the various organizations may hold meetings
to discuss measures appertaining to the national salvation
activities under the pretence that they have gathered to
celebrate the New Year.

On receiving the notice, the responsible officer of the
organization should immediately discuss measures to carry out a
propaganda campaign. All the organizations should send in their
reports before January 7, 1938, on the result of their activities.

Tsu Wei (pseudonym of the Shanghai Vocational
Circles National Salvation Association).
17/12/37.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

5. 在该周期间，各团体应劝说民众写信给蒋将军，以示对抗战的支持。

6. 职业界救国会已准备了大量“救国”贺卡，将分发给中国人和外国人。请其他团体效仿此举。

7. 职业界救国会已准备了大量国旗，将分发给里弄居民及各商店，以便他们在纪念日悬挂。请其他团体 likewise（同样）行事。

8. 在向居民和商店分发国旗时，应告知民众支持国旗的重要性。如果可能，可以组建名为“十人护旗会”的组织。

9. 各团体应诱导居民和商店于1937年12月25日和1938年1月1日悬挂旗帜。

10. 1938年1月1日，各团体可借庆祝新年之名举行会议，讨论与救国活动相关的措施。

收到通告后，各团体负责人应立即讨论开展宣传运动的措施。所有团体应于1938年1月7日前提交活动结果报告。

祖伟（上海职业界救国会的化名）。
1937年12月17日。

Notice No. 7 : The unfavourable political situation
in Shanghai and the conducting of secret
Activities.

The circumstances in the foreign concession in Shanghai
have taken a turn for the worse and have been apparent ever
since the withdrawal of the Chinese troops from this area.
The British and French authorities have made concession
after concession to the Japanese troops, who, after having
created the Nanking Road Incident, have conducted searches
in the Great Eastern Hotel and houses on the extra-Settlement
roads and arrested a number of Chinese. Although protests
were filed with the Japanese authorities by the British
Consulate-General and the Shanghai Municipal Council, the
former have turned a deaf ear to them.

Meanwhile, the Shanghai Municipal Council announced
that persons, who rendered assistance to the Chinese troops
prior to their withdrawal from Shanghai, would be protected
but no protection whatever would be given to those persons
who undertook anti-Japanese activities thereafter. The
proclamation shows clearly that the Shanghai Municipal
Council under the influence of the Japanese troops have
taken steps to suppress all national salvation movements.
At present the Japanese troops are buying over a large
number of traitors with a view to engaging them in frustrating
the national salvation movements. In order to avoid a
setback, national salvation bodies are hereby instructed
to pay close attention to their activities and keep them
as secret as possible. The following three points must be
understood thoroughly:-

(1) It must be clearly noted that the activities will
have to be conducted secretly but by no means suspended.

第七号通告：上海不利的政治局势及开展秘密活动。

自中国军队从该地区撤离以来，上海外国租界的局势已发生恶化，且显而易见。英法当局对日军一再让步，日军在制造南京路事件后，搜查了汇中饭店（Great Eastern Hotel）及越界筑路区域的房屋，并逮捕了一些中国人。尽管英国驻沪总领事馆和上海公共租界工部局向日本当局提出了抗议，但后者置若罔闻。

与此同时，上海公共租界工部局宣布，在中国军队撤离上海之前曾协助中国军队的人员将受到保护，但此后从事反日活动的人员将得不到任何保护。该公告清楚地表明，上海公共租界工部局在日军的影响下，已采取措施镇压所有救国运动。目前，日军正在收买大量汉奸，旨在让他们破坏救国运动。为避免遭受挫折，特此指示各救国团体密切关注其活动，并尽可能保持秘密。必须彻底理解以下三点：-

(1) 必须明确注意，活动必须秘密进行，但绝不可停止。

(C) An organization should establish a communication

members in order to maintain a constant close
contact with other organizations.

(D) Offices of the organizations should be removed
from time to time.

Notice No. 8

Soliciting the opinion of the various organizations
regarding the disbursement of the fund raised for
purchasing gloves for Chinese soldiers defending
Greater Shanghai.

No sooner had this organization initiated the
campaign for raising funds to purchase gloves for Chinese
soldiers defending Greater Shanghai than the Chinese troops
began to withdraw from this area. Up to the present, the
Cultural Circles Race Salvation Association, the Women's
Circles National Salvation Association, and the Students
Circles' National Salvation Association have collected a
total sum of about $5,000.00 while this association alone
raised some $4,000.00. In consequence of the change
in the military situation, the money raised cannot be
used in the way it was intended. A joint meeting of the
various national salvation associations was held and it
was decided that the fund be allotted to the following
purposes:-

1. To console the Chinese troops and police constables
at present accommodated in the foreign concessions.
2. For the relief of the refugees.
3. To defray expenses incurred by the national salvation
association associationsin conducting their activities.

The various national salvation associations have
decided to allot the fund raised by them equally for the
above three items. This association, however, wishes to
solicit the opinion of its members and the persons, who
had contributed the fund, regarding the disbursement of the
money. The latter are requested to hand in their suggestions
within five days so that the problem can be solved without
further delay. The money is at present in the custody of
the Cultural Circles Race Salvation Association, the
Vocational Circles National Salvation Association and the
Women's Circles National Salvation Association.

Tsu Wei (朱 惠) (Pseudonym of the Vocational
Circles National Salvation Assn.)

第八号通告

就为大上海防卫战中的中国士兵购买手套所筹款项的支用问题，征求各组织意见。

本会发起为保卫大上海的中国士兵筹集资金购买手套的运动不久，中国军队便开始从该地区撤离。截至目前，文化界救国会、妇女界救国会和学生界救国会共筹集约5,000.00美元，而本会单独筹集了约4,000.00美元。由于军事局势的变化，所筹资金无法按原定用途使用。各救国会举行了联席会议，决定将该笔资金分配用于以下目的：-

1. 慰问目前安置在外国租界内的中国军队和警察巡捕。
2. 救济难民。
3. 支付各救国会在开展活动过程中产生的费用。

各救国会已决定将各自筹集的资金平均分配于上述三项用途。然而，本会希望就款项支用问题征求本会会员及捐款人的意见。请后者在五天内提交建议，以便尽快解决此问题。目前，该笔资金由文化界救国会、职业界救国会和妇女界救国会保管。

朱惠（职业界救国会化名）
